summary_en: Shin-Etsu Chemical announced a special commemorative dividend of 20 yen per share for the interim dividend in fiscal 2027 (year ending March 2027) to celebrate its 100th anniversary on September 16, 2026. Total annual dividend guidance for fiscal 2027 is revised upward to 136 yen per share, comprising ordinary interim dividend of 58 yen, special dividend of 20 yen, and year-end dividend of 58 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of Centennial Commemorative Dividend and Revision of Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
On September 15, 2026, Shin-Etsu Chemical's board of directors approved a special commemorative dividend in recognition of the company's 100th anniversary, which occurs on September 16, 2026. The interim dividend for fiscal 2027 (year ending March 31, 2027) will include a regular ordinary dividend of 58 yen per share plus a commemorative dividend of 20 yen per share, totaling 78 yen. The year-end dividend remains at 58 yen per share, bringing the total annual dividend to 136 yen, revised upward from the previously announced guidance of 116 yen.

The company stated that the special dividend is intended to express gratitude to shareholders for their support over the past century and to commemorate the milestone together. The interim dividend decision will be formally resolved at the board meeting scheduled for October 2026. The year-end dividend forecast of 58 yen per share remains unchanged from the prior guidance.
